class.name: OcgBrepmeshMeshtool
class.brief_description: Auxiliary tool providing API for manipulation with BRepMesh_DataStructureOfDelaun.
class.description: ! Auxiliary tool providing API for manipulation with BRepMesh_DataStructureOfDelaun.

method.name: BRepMesh_MeshTool
method.description: Constructor. Initializes tool by the given data structure.

method.name: GetStructure
method.description: Returns data structure manipulated by this tool.

method.name: AddAndLegalizeTriangle
method.description: Adds new triangle with specified nodes to mesh. Legalizes triangle in case if it violates circle criteria.

method.name: AddLink
method.description: Adds new link to mesh. Updates link index and link orientation parameters.

method.name: Legalize
method.description: Performs legalization of triangles connected to the specified link.

method.name: EraseItemsConnectedTo
method.description: Erases all elements connected to the specified artificial node. In addition, erases the artificial node itself.

method.name: CleanFrontierLinks
method.description: Cleans frontier links from triangles to the right.

method.name: EraseFreeLinks_1
method.description: Erases all links that have no elements connected to them.
